title: Introducing Microsoft Copilot for legal
summary: In legal work, the answer rarely sits neatly in one place. It may depend on precedent, organizational standards, or a regulatory consideration that changes the whole analysis.

title: Microsoft 365: Frontier expands to public previews in Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and SharePoint
summary: Frontier is expanding to bring eligible public preview features across Microsoft 365 into one program. Users enrolled in Frontier can get eligible previews for new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Copilot, managed through a single admin-controlled enrollment experience. Frontier enrollment is optional and separate from Standard and Deferred release preferences for generally available features. Existing Frontier users do not need to re-enroll. More info: https://lea
